name: Script Resources
description: Completion in map scripts and custom text (JASS, vJASS): inside strings the files a parameter wants (models for modelName, icons, sound files) from the game and the map's imports, sound labels and order strings; inside rawcodes ('hfoo') the game's and the map's objects with their names, narrowed by the parameter (unitId → units, abilityId → abilities, …). Ctrl+Space shows the list anywhere.
